framework_lessons: Stress-test income assets against refinancing and valuation changes.
assessment: Bitcoin met the explicit two-year directional horizon, and the proposed QT-taper sequence occurred. The utility discussion correctly separates earnings growth from multiple risk. NextEra rose but lagged SPY in the chosen two-year window; Pepsi fell and AWK barely advanced. Reporting-law scope, Saudi membership certainty and the NEE/NEP business description require correction or qualification. The decade return forecast remains open.
verification_limitations: Retrieved November 7, 2026; the current webpage is not authenticated as the original publication-date wording.
Chart labels were read but pixels and proprietary indicator vintages were not inspected.

Adjusted-close evidence is a vendor proxy for reinvested distributions and splits, in USD without fees or taxes. It does not reconstruct actual portfolio trades. Chosen sensitivity windows are not author deadlines. Macro series use latest vintages.
